questions.question: Sara said, "I am happy." What did Sara say?
options: Sara said that she was happy.
Sara said that I am happy.
questions.correct_answer: Sara said that she was happy.
questions.explanation_ar: عند نقل الكلام في الماضي، تتحول am غالبًا إلى was، ويتغير الضمير I إلى she.

questions.question: My teacher _____ me to open my book.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم told عندما نذكر الشخص الذي وُجّه إليه الكلام: told me.

questions.question: You are a student, _____?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة مثبتة، لذلك نستخدم سؤالًا قصيرًا منفيًا: aren't you?

questions.question: The woman _____ teaches us English is very kind.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم who للإشارة إلى الأشخاص.

questions.question: The boy speaks _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الظرف quietly لوصف طريقة تحدث الولد، وغالبًا نضيف ly إلى الصفة.

questions.question: Can I _____ your pencil? I will give it back tomorrow.
questions.explanation_ar: borrow تعني يستعير شيئًا من شخص، أما lend فتعني يُعير شيئًا لشخص.

questions.question: Please _____ this book to your teacher.
questions.explanation_ar: take تعني تأخذ الشيء إلى مكان أو شخص آخر.

questions.question: Which phrase is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الشائع والصحيح هو make a decision أي يتخذ قرارًا.

questions.question: Match each school word with its meaning.

pairs.right: A place to read or borrow books

questions.explanation_ar: المطلوب ربط كل كلمة مدرسية بمعناها الصحيح.

questions.question: Mona _____ brushes her teeth before sleeping. She never forgets.
questions.explanation_ar: always تعني دائمًا، وهي مناسبة لأن الجملة تقول إنها لا تنسى أبدًا.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: Ali said that he is tired.
questions.correct_answer: Ali said that he was tired.
questions.explanation_ar: في نقل الكلام باستخدام said في الماضي، تتحول is عادةً إلى was.

questions.question: She can swim, _____?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة مثبتة وتستخدم can، لذلك يكون السؤال القصير منفيًا: can't she?

questions.question: Which invention helps people see very small objects?
questions.explanation_ar: المجهر microscope يساعدنا على رؤية الأشياء الصغيرة جدًا.

questions.question: What should you do before crossing a road?
questions.explanation_ar: يجب النظر في الاتجاهين والتأكد من خلو الطريق قبل العبور.

questions.question: This is the school _____ my mother works.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم where عندما نتحدث عن المكان.

questions.passage: Last Thursday, our school held a science fair. Students showed different inventions. Omar made a small robot that could move forward and turn left. His classmates asked many questions. The judges liked his project because it was useful and creative. Omar felt proud of his work.
questions.question: What did Omar make?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن عمر صنع روبوتًا صغيرًا يستطيع التحرك إلى الأمام والانعطاف يسارًا.

questions.question: Why did the judges like Omar's project?
questions.explanation_ar: ورد في النص أن الحكام أعجبوا بالمشروع لأنه مفيد وإبداعي.

questions.question: How did Omar feel about his work?
questions.explanation_ar: النص يقول إن عمر شعر بالفخر بعمله.

questions.question: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.correct_answer: The student did the experiment carefully.
questions.explanation_ar: نبدأ بالفاعل The student، ثم الفعل did، ثم المفعول به the experiment، وأخيرًا الظرف carefully.

questions.question: When people work together to reach a goal, this is called _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Teamwork تعني العمل الجماعي والتعاون لتحقيق هدف مشترك.

questions.question: I wanted to play outside, _____ it was raining.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم but للربط بين فكرتين متعارضتين.

questions.question: What does the word "invent" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: الفعل invent يعني يخترع أو ينشئ شيئًا جديدًا.

questions.question: Write two or three sentences about a useful invention you would like to create.

rubric.sample_answer: I want to invent a smart school bag. It will carry books and remind students about homework.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب عن اختراع تتمنى صنعه، واشرح فائدته باستخدام جمل إنجليزية بسيطة.

questions.question: Your classroom is untidy after an activity. What can you and your classmates do?

rubric.sample_answer: We can work together, pick up the rubbish, and put the chairs in the right places.

questions.explanation_ar: فكر في حل عملي للمشكلة، واذكر كيف يمكن للطلاب التعاون.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The girl which lives here is my friend.
The girl who lives here is my friend.
The girl where lives here is my friend.
The girl whom live here is my friend.
questions.correct_answer: The girl who lives here is my friend.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم who للإشارة إلى الفتاة لأنها شخص، ويأتي الفعل lives مع المفرد.
